description: This file contains a Java class 'TaxAuthorityServices' which provides services related to tax calculations and adjustments within the Ofbiz framework, specifically handling tax rates, adjustments, exemptions, and related tax authority logic.

classes.name: TaxAuthorityServices
classes.description: Provides services for calculating tax rates and adjusting tax-related data within the Ofbiz framework.

methods.name: rateProductTaxCalcForDisplay
methods.description: Calculates the total tax and price including VAT for display purposes, based on product and store information.

methods.name: rateProductTaxCalc
methods.description: Calculates applicable tax adjustments for a list of products or a single product, taking into account various settings like location, store, and tax authorities.

methods.name: getTaxAuthorities
methods.description: Determines the relevant tax authorities based on shipping address geo IDs.

methods.name: getTaxAdjustments
methods.description: Fetches tax adjustments based on product, store, location, and tax rate data, including various filters and conditions.

methods.name: getProductPrice
methods.description: Retrieves the product price with respect to the tax authority and store context.

methods.name: setProductCategoryCond
methods.description: Creates a condition to match product categories relevant for tax calculations.

methods.name: handlePartyTaxExempt
methods.description: Checks and applies tax exemption or tax ID based on party relationships and tax authority info.

methods.name: getTaxAuthorities
methods.description: Expands geo regions and finds tax authorities applicable to the given shipping address.
